title: Integrated Clinical and Proteomic Precision Subgrouping for Severe Dengue Endotype Signature
abstract: Abstract Background Severe dengue remains difficult to predict because patients with different clinical trajectories may present with overlapping features, and conventional severity classifications may not fully capture underlying biological heterogeneity. In this study, we applied an integrated clinical and proteomic endotyping approach to dissect dengue disease heterogeneity and identify molecular signatures associated with severity. Methods Plasma proteomic profiles were analyzed together with detailed clinical, biochemical, hematological, coagulation, and immunological parameters from healthy controls and dengue patients classified according to WHO 2009 severity criteria. High-throughput proteomic analysis, unsupervised clustering, pathway enrichment, and machine-learning–based classification were used to identify dengue endotypes and define molecular features associated with predicted severe disease. Results Increasing dengue severity was associated with progressive abnormalities in liver function, coagulation parameters, hematological indices, and inflammatory mediators, including IL-6, IL-15, HGF, and MUC-16. However, proteomic profiling revealed substantial overlap across conventional severity categories, indicating that clinical classification alone does not fully resolve dengue host-response heterogeneity. Integrated clinical-proteomic clustering identified distinct dengue endotypes, including a predicted severe endotype enriched for inflammatory, antiviral, and cytotoxic lymphocyte-associated pathways. This high-risk endotype was characterized by elevated IL-15, IFN-γ, and granzymes, consistent with coordinated activation of cytotoxic lymphocyte-associated antiviral responses. Machine-learning analysis further showed that proteomic features were strong discriminators of this endotype, supporting their potential utility as biomarkers of severe host-response states. Conclusion Integrated clinical-proteomic endotyping provides molecular resolution beyond conventional severity grading and identifies immune pathways associated with severe dengue. This framework may improve biological understanding of dengue progression and support future risk stratification and biomarker development.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 重症登革热 仍然难以预测,因为具有不同临床轨迹的患者可能呈现重叠的特征,并且传统的严重程度分类可能无法完全捕捉潜在的生物异质性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项研究中,采用综合的临床和蛋白质组内分型方法来剖析登革热疾病的异质性并识别与严重程度相关的分子特征。
elements_zh.methods: 对健康对照者和根据 WHO 2009 年严重程度标准分类的登革热患者的血浆蛋白质组图谱以及详细的临床、生化、血液学、凝血和免疫学参数进行了分析。高通量蛋白质组分析、无监督聚类、通路富集和基于机器学习的分类被用来识别登革热内型并定义与预测的严重疾病相关的分子特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 登革热严重程度的增加与肝功能、凝血参数、血液学指标和炎症介质(包括 IL-6、IL-15、HGF 和 MUC-16)的进行性异常相关。蛋白质组学分析显示传统严重程度类别之间存在大量重叠,表明仅临床分类并不能完全解决登革热 宿主 反应异质性。综合临床蛋白质组聚类鉴定出不同的登革热内型,包括预测的富含炎症、抗病毒药物 和细胞毒性淋巴细胞相关途径的严重内型。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 集成的临床蛋白质组内分型提供了超越传统严重程度分级的分子分辨率,并确定了与 重症登革热 相关的免疫途径。该框架可以提高对登革热进展的生物学理解,并支持未来的风险分层和生物标志物开发。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 确定的蛋白质组学特征和内型可以为 重症登革热 风险分层生物标志物的开发提供信息,并增强对驱动疾病进展的 宿主 反应机制的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象级别的证据,缺乏详细的方法、统计或数字报告,这限制了结论的强度。由于缺乏完整的方法和结果细节,证据强度被评估为低。

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 重症登革热 仍然难以预测,因为具有不同临床轨迹的患者可能表现出重叠的特征,并且传统的严重程度分类可能无法完全捕捉潜在的生物异质性。在这项研究中,我们应用综合的临床和蛋白质组内分型方法来剖析登革热疾病的异质性并确定与严重程度相关的分子特征。方法 对健康对照者和根据 WHO 2009 年严重程度标准分类的登革热患者的血浆蛋白质组谱以及详细的临床、生化、血液学、凝血和免疫学参数进行分析。高通量蛋白质组分析、无监督聚类、通路富集和基于机器学习的分类被用来识别登革热内型并定义与预测的严重疾病相关的分子特征。结果 登革热严重程度的增加与肝功能、凝血参数、血液学指标和炎症介质(包括 IL-6、IL-15、HGF 和 MUC-16)的进行性异常相关。然而,蛋白质组学分析显示传统严重程度类别之间存在大量重叠,表明仅临床分类并不能完全解决登革热 宿主 反应异质性。综合临床蛋白质组聚类鉴定出不同的登革热内型,包括预测的富含炎症、抗病毒药物 和细胞毒性淋巴细胞相关途径的严重内型。这种高风险内型的特点是 IL-15、IFN-γ 和颗粒酶升高,与细胞毒性淋巴细胞相关 抗病毒药物 反应的协调激活一致。机器学习分析进一步表明,蛋白质组学特征是这种内型的强有力的鉴别器,支持它们作为严重 宿主 反应状态的生物标志物的潜在用途。结论 整合的临床蛋白质组内分型提供了超越传统严重程度分级的分子分辨率,并确定了与 重症登革热 相关的免疫途径。该框架可以提高对登革热进展的生物学理解,并支持未来的风险分层和生物标志物开发。

analysis_zh.methods: 对健康对照者和根据 WHO 2009 年严重程度标准分类的登革热患者的血浆蛋白质组图谱以及详细的临床、生化、血液学、凝血和免疫学参数进行了分析。高通量蛋白质组分析、无监督聚类、通路富集和基于机器学习的分类被用来识别登革热内型并定义与预测的严重疾病相关的分子特征。
analysis_zh.main_results: 登革热严重程度的增加与肝功能、凝血参数、血液学指标和炎症介质(包括 IL-6、IL-15、HGF 和 MUC-16)的进行性异常相关。蛋白质组学分析显示传统严重程度类别之间存在大量重叠,表明仅临床分类并不能完全解决登革热 宿主 反应异质性。综合临床蛋白质组聚类鉴定出不同的登革热内型,包括预测的富含炎症、抗病毒药物 和细胞毒性淋巴细胞相关途径的严重内型。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 集成的临床蛋白质组内分型提供了超越传统严重程度分级的分子分辨率,并确定了与 重症登革热 相关的免疫途径。该框架可以提高对登革热进展的生物学理解,并支持未来的风险分层和生物标志物开发。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 确定的蛋白质组学特征和内型可以为 重症登革热 风险分层生物标志物的开发提供信息,并增强对驱动疾病进展的 宿主 反应机制的理解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象级别的证据,缺乏详细的方法、统计或数字报告,这限制了结论的强度。由于缺乏完整的方法和结果细节,证据强度被评估为低。

title: Hesitancy and Perceptions Regarding Dengue Vaccination Among Educated Ecuadorians.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Global dengue cases have surged in recent years. In Ecuador, reported cases increased from 27,906 in 2023 to 57,712 in 2024. Despite the availability of multiple vaccines in other countries, factors such as socioeconomic disparities, climate change, and vaccine hesitancy continue to hinder prevention efforts. This study aims to analyze the perceptions of the Ecuadorian population and explore possible reasons for hesitancy toward the dengue vaccine. METHODS: This cross-sectional observational study was conducted in accordance with the STROBE guidelines. Online surveys, adapted from Kricorian et al., were distributed via the Qualtrics app between June 1st, 2024, and June 25, 2025. Eligible participants were Ecuadorian, at least 18 years old, and had a minimal education level of bachelor. Statistical analysis included descriptive percentages and chi-square tests, with significance set at p < 0.05. RESULTS: A total of 735 participants were included. Most perceived a dengue vaccine as safe (87.2%, n = 641), while 12.8% (n = 94) considered it unsafe. Overall, 75.9% expressed willingness to be vaccinated. Perceived vaccine safety was significantly associated with vaccination willingness, region of residence, and willingness to vaccinate offspring (all p < 0.001), but not with education level, dengue understanding (p = 0.747), or prior dengue experience (p = 0.111). CONCLUSION: Most Ecuadorians perceive dengue vaccines as safe, yet hesitancy persists. Targeted educational efforts are essential to improve acceptance and coverage.

abstract_zh: 背景:近年来,全球登革热病例激增。在厄瓜多尔,报告病例从 2023 年的 27,906 例增加到 2024 年的 57,712 例。尽管其他国家可以使用多种 疫苗,但社会经济差异、气候变化和 疫苗 犹豫等因素继续阻碍预防工作。本研究旨在分析厄瓜多尔民众的看法,并探讨对登革热 疫苗 犹豫不决的可能原因。方法:这项横断面观察性研究是根据 STROBE 指南进行的。改编自 Kricorian 等人的在线调查,于 2024 年 6 月 1 日至 2025 年 6 月 25 日期间通过 Qualtrics 应用程序分发。符合条件的参与者是厄瓜多尔人,年满 18 岁,最低教育水平为学士。统计分析包括描述性百分比和卡方检验,显着性设置为 p < 0.05。结果:共有 735 名参与者被纳入。大多数人认为登革热 疫苗 是安全的(87.2%,n = 641),而 12.8%(n = 94)认为它不安全。总体而言,75.9%的人表示愿意接种疫苗。感知的 疫苗 安全性与 疫苗接种 意愿、居住地区和为后代接种疫苗的意愿显着相关(均 p < 0.001),但与教育水平、登革热了解(p = 0.747)或既往登革热经历(p = 0.111)无关。结论:大多数厄瓜多尔人认为登革热 疫苗 是安全的,但仍然犹豫不决。有针对性的教育工作对于提高接受度和覆盖率至关重要。

title: Epidemiology and Serology of Dengue in Imphal Valley: An Institutional Study
abstract: Introduction: Dengue is a pandemic disease with a substantial global burden and can be fatal. Effective dengue control measures should consider the location of outbreaks, relevant demographic parameters, and the diagnostic testing techniques used. Aims: This study evaluated the epidemiological and demographic characteristics of dengue and the diagnostic testing techniques used in Imphal Valley. Materials and Methods: This prospective study was conducted at the Escent Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences & Research (NABL-accredited Diagnostic Laboratory), Imphal, Manipur. All clinically suspected dengue cases reported by government and private hospitals in Imphal were included from September 2023 to December 2025. Microsoft Excel 2019 was used for data analysis. Results: Of 3,424 samples received from clinically suspected dengue cases, 1,514 (44.22%) were positive, comprising 735 male and 779 female cases. Cases positive only for NS1 were the most frequent, indicating early infection, followed by cases positive for both NS1 and IgM. Conclusion: Imphal experienced dengue outbreaks in three consecutive years from 2023 to 2025. The largest outbreak during the study period occurred in 2025, driven by a sharp increase in cases. Efforts to control mosquito breeding habitats in high-risk areas should be intensified by removing containers of stagnant water to reduce the density of Aedes mosquitoes.
journal: Journal of Advances in Biology & Biotechnology

Aims: This study evaluated the epidemiological and demographic characteristics of dengue and the diagnostic testing techniques used in Imphal Valley. Materials and Methods: This prospective study was conducted at the Escent Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences & Research (NABL-accredited Diagnostic Laboratory), Imphal, Manipur. All clinically suspected dengue cases reported by government and private hospitals in Imphal were included from September 2023 to December 2025. Microsoft Excel 2019 was used for data analysis. Results: Of 3,424 samples received from clinically suspected dengue cases, 1,514 (44.22%) were positive, comprising 735 male and 779 female cases. Cases positive only for NS1 were the most frequent, indicating early infection, followed by cases positive for both NS1 and IgM. Conclusion: Imphal experienced dengue outbreaks in three consecutive years from 2023 to 2025. The largest outbreak during the study period occurred in 2025, driven by a sharp increase in cases. Efforts to control mosquito breeding habitats in high-risk areas should be intensified by removing containers of stagnant water to reduce the density of Aedes mosquitoes.
source_records.journal: Journal of Advances in Biology & Biotechnology

analysis.summary_en: This prospective institutional study in Imphal Valley evaluated the epidemiology and serology of dengue from September 2023 to December 2025. Among 3,424 clinically suspected cases, 44.22% were confirmed positive, with a near-equal gender distribution. Early infection markers (NS1) predominated, followed by dual NS1/IgM positivity, indicating recent transmission. The study documented three consecutive years of dengue outbreaks, with 2025 experiencing the largest surge. Findings emphasize the importance of targeted vector control in high-risk areas and prioritizing NS1-based diagnostics for early outbreak detection.

title: Understanding dengue dynamics: spatiotemporal evidence of control failure, inequalities, and the role of climate factors
abstract: Abstract Background Dengue remains a pressing public health issue in Brazil, where vector control strategies often suffer from limited effectiveness and sustainability. Although the Brazilian National Dengue Control Program (PNCD) operates with standardized guidelines, few studies have evaluated its long-term effectiveness at the local level, with a consistent dengue transmission history and structured intervention efforts under the PNCD. Moreover, previous research at aggregated scales has shown conflicting associations between socioeconomic development and dengue incidence, highlighting the need for small-area spatiotemporal analyses. Methods We conducted a Bayesian spatiotemporal analysis using Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA) to assess quarterly dengue incidence in São José do Rio Preto (SJRP), Brazil, from 2012–2024. The model incorporated environmental, entomological, and socioeconomic covariates from census tracts. Results The findings revealed that vector control actions were predominantly reactive and intensified after case surges. Increased literacy rates were associated with a decreased dengue incidence rate, whereas higher relative deprivation increased the risk. These results differ from those of regional studies that associate higher socioeconomic development with an increased dengue burden, emphasizing the value of small-scale analysis to uncover local vulnerabilities. Climatic variables had nonlinear effects, with elevated temperatures and rainfall associated with increased risk. Spatial risk patterns varied significantly over time, with no consistent high-risk clusters. Given the standardized implementation of the PNCD, the SJRP serves as a suitable proxy for assessing the program’s broader effectiveness across Brazil. Conclusion This study underscores the limitations of reactive dengue control strategies and the need for more proactive, integrated, and socially contextualized approaches to address this issue. Small-area analyses provide critical insights into the heterogeneous dynamics of disease transmission and social vulnerability. Expanding the use of innovative tools, such as Wolbachia-based control and sterile insects, among others, may strengthen long-term prevention and guide the development of more resilient national policies.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热在巴西仍然是一个紧迫的公共卫生问题,媒介 控制策略的有效性和可持续性往往有限。尽管巴西国家登革热控制计划 (PNCD) 按照标准化指南运作,但很少有研究评估其在地方一级的长期有效性,以及 PNCD 下一致的登革热 传播 历史和结构化干预工作。此外,之前的总体规模研究表明,社会经济发展与登革热 发病率 之间存在相互矛盾的关联,凸显了小区域时空分析的必要性。方法 我们使用综合嵌套拉普拉斯近似 (INLA) 进行贝叶斯时空分析,以评估 2012 年至 2024 年巴西普雷图河畔圣若泽 (SJRP) 的季度登革热 发病率。该模型结合了人口普查区的环境、昆虫学和社会经济协变量。结果 调查结果显示,媒介 控制行动主要是反应性的,并且在病例激增后得到加强。识字率的提高与登革热 发病率 率的降低相关,而相对剥夺程度的提高则增加了风险。这些结果不同于区域研究的结果,区域研究将较高的社会经济发展与登革热负担增加联系起来,强调了小规模分析发现当地脆弱性的价值。气候变量具有非线性效应,气温升高和降雨量增加与风险增加相关。空间风险模式随时间变化显着,没有一致的高风险集群。鉴于 PNCD 的标准化实施,SJRP 可以作为评估该计划在巴西各地更广泛有效性的合适代理。结论 本研究强调了反应性登革热控制策略的局限性,以及需要采取更主动、综合和社会背景化的方法来解决这一问题。小区域分析为疾病 传播 和社会脆弱性的异质动态提供了重要见解。扩大创新工具的使用,例如基于沃尔巴克氏体的控制和昆虫不育等,可以加强长期预防并指导制定更具弹性的国家政策。

title: Dengue Fever Complicated by Intracerebral Haemorrhage, Acute Respiratory Failure and Nosocomial Pneumonia: A Case Report
abstract: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral illness caused by the dengue virus. Majority of cases have self-limiting course, rarely severe dengue causes fatal neurological complications like encephalitis and haemorrhage. This is case report of a 38-year-old male who presented with three days of high-grade fever, one day of altered sensorium, headache, and generalised weakness. Serological testing confirmed dengue IgM positivity. The clinical course was complicated by a rapid decline in Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) from 15 to 11, necessitating endotracheal intubation on day two in the setting of blood-stained pulmonary secretions. Highresolution Computed Tomography (CT) of the thorax suggested consolidation with pulmonary oedema. CT of the brain revealed a 3.9×3.8×3.5 cm Intracerebral Parenchymal Haemorrhage (IPH) with surrounding oedema causing significant mass effect. Laboratory parameters documented severe thrombocytopaenia (nadir 0.6 lac/cumm), coagulopathy, hepatocellular injury with peak SGOT/ SGPT of 227/276 IU/L, and elevated C-reactive protein at 85.6 mg/L. Endotracheal aspirate cultures grew extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii on day five, requiring escalation of antimicrobial therapy to meropenem and polymyxin. Supportive management included platelet and Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP) transfusion. The patient was successfully extubated on day nine and discharged home on day twelve. Notably, the simultaneous occurrence of dengue-associated Intracerebral Haemorrhage (ICH), acute hypoxaemic respiratory failure, and Multi-Drug Resistant (MDR) nosocomial pneumonia in a young immunocompetent adult represents a triad that is rarely documented in the published literature. Early recognition of neurological deterioration, timely neuroimaging, aggressive blood product support, and targeted antimicrobial therapy with conservative management of ICH remains critical determinants of a favourable outcome.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old male with dengue fever confirmed by IgM serology who developed severe complications including intracerebral haemorrhage, acute respiratory failure requiring intubation, and multi-drug resistant nosocomial pneumonia. Clinically, he exhibited rapid neurological deterioration, severe thrombocytopaenia, coagulopathy, and hepatocellular injury. Management involved supportive care with platelet and FFP transfusions, early neuroimaging, and targeted antimicrobial therapy. The patient was successfully extubated on day nine and discharged on day twelve. The simultaneous occurrence of these severe complications in a young immunocompetent adult is rarely documented, highlighting the need for heightened clinical vigilance in dengue cases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是一种蚊媒病毒性疾病,病程主要为自限性,但严重病例可导致罕见但致命的神经系统并发症,如脑炎和出血。该研究强调需要记录登革热感染的非典型和严重表现,以提高临床识别和管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一名 38 岁男性的 病例报告,他出现三天高烧、感觉改变、头痛和全身无力。患者接受了支持治疗,包括血小板和新鲜冰冻血浆输注。
elements_zh.methods: 血清学检测显示登革热 IgM 阳性,证实了登革热 诊断。支持治疗包括输血,并在整个住院期间进行临床监测。
elements_zh.main_results: 该患者的格拉斯哥昏迷评分从 15 分下降至 11 分,由于肺部分泌物带血,需要在第二天进行气管插管。脑部CT扫描显示3.9×3.8×3.5厘米的脑实质出血,周围水肿,造成明显的占位效应。实验室检查结果包括严重血小板减少症(最低 0.6 lac/cumm)、凝血病、肝细胞损伤(SGOT/SGPT 峰值为 227/276 IU/L)以及 C 反应蛋白升高(85.6 mg/L)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在免疫功能正常的年轻成人中同时发生登革热相关脑出血、急性低氧血症性呼吸衰竭和多重耐药医院肺炎是已发表文献中很少记录的三联征。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例强调了早期识别神经功能恶化、及时进行神经影像学检查、积极的血液制品支持和靶向抗菌治疗在管理 重症登革热 并发症中的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为单个 病例报告,证据的普遍性有限,无法建立因果关系。由于缺乏比较数据或更广泛的临床背景,证据强度较低。

title: Monocyte TLR2/4 as predictive biomarkers for progression from dengue warning signs to severe disease
abstract: Background The World Health Organization (WHO) classification system, comprising dengue fever (DF), dengue with warning signs (DWS), and severe dengue (SD), has been widely adopted globally; however, clinical management remains challenging. Current warning sign criteria lack specificity, frequently failing to distinguish patients progressing to severe disease from those with transient illness, thereby contributing to delayed interventions and missed therapeutic windows. Although Toll-like receptors (TLRs) mediate innate antiviral immunity and are implicated in severe dengue pathogenesis, their expression dynamics during the critical DWS transition window, a phase in which intervention could prevent progression to severe disease, remain entirely unknown. Methods An integrated biomarker discovery study was conducted, comprising bioinformatics analysis of publicly available single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data (GSE220969) and experimental validation in an independent clinical cohort of 45 dengue patients and 10 healthy controls (H) in Guangdong Province, China. Phase-specific immune signatures were identified from the scRNA-seq data. TLRs expression was quantified by multiparameter flow cytometry. Diagnostic performance was assessed using ROC curve analysis, and correlations with clinical laboratory parameters were evaluated using Spearman’s rank correlation. Results Bioinformatics analysis of 23 cell clusters revealed that TLR2/4/7/8 expression peaked specifically during the DWS phase, predominantly in monocytes. Flow cytometry confirmed elevated surface TLR2 (AUC 0.874) and TLR4 (AUC 0.763) in DWS versus other phases, with discriminatory capacity to distinguish DWS from SD (TLR2: AUC 0.833; TLR4: AUC 0.810). Moreover, correlation analysis of TLRs expression with clinical indicators demonstrated that the expression levels of TLR2 and TLR4 were associated with the development of SD. Conclusions Elevated monocyte TLR2/4 expression during DWS identifies patients at risk for progression to severe dengue before clinical decompensation. These mechanism-informed biomarkers provide a foundation for point-of-care risk stratification in endemic regions.

abstract_zh: 背景 世界卫生组织(WHO)分类系统,包括登革热(DF)、带有警告标志的登革热(DWS)和重症登革热(SD),已在全球广泛采用;然而,临床管理仍然具有挑战性。目前的警告信号标准缺乏特异性,常常无法区分进展为严重疾病的患者与短暂性疾病的患者,从而导致干预措施延迟和错过治疗窗口。尽管 Toll 样受体 (TLR) 介导先天 抗病毒药物 免疫并与 重症登革热 发病机制 相关,但它们在关键 DWS 转换窗口(干预可以防止进展为严重疾病的阶段)期间的表达动态仍然完全未知。方法进行了一项综合生物标志物发现研究,包括对公开的单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据 (GSE220969) 进行生物信息学分析,并在中国广东省 45 名登革热患者和 10 名健康对照 (H) 的独立临床 队列研究 中进行实验验证。从 scRNA-seq 数据中鉴定出阶段特异性免疫特征。通过多参数流式细胞术对 TLR 表达进行定量。使用 ROC 曲线分析评估诊断性能,并使用 Spearman 等级相关性评估与临床实验室参数的相关性。结果 23 个细胞簇的生物信息学分析表明,TLR2/4/7/8 表达在 DWS 阶段达到峰值,主要在单核细胞中。流式细胞术证实,与其他阶段相比,DWS 中表面 TLR2 (AUC 0.874) 和 TLR4 (AUC 0.763) 升高,具有区分 DWS 和 SD 的辨别能力 (TLR2: AUC 0.833;TLR4: AUC 0.810)。此外,TLRs表达与临床指标的相关性分析表明,TLR2和TLR4的表达水平与SD的发生发展相关。结论 DWS 期间单核细胞 TLR2/4 表达升高可识别患者在临床失代偿前有进展为 重症登革热 的风险。这些基于机制的生物标志物为流行地区的护理点风险分层提供了基础。

title: A Hybrid Agent-Based Model of Urban Dengue Transmission: City Specific Adaptation and Validation in Santa Marta, Colombia
abstract: Urban transmission of dengue and other Aedes aegypti-borne diseases is shaped by the interaction of vector ecology, human mobility, climate, and spatial heterogeneity. Capturing these interactions in city-specific settings requires models that are detailed enough to represent local transmission processes, while remaining computationally feasible for calibration, validation, and sensitivity analysis. This study presents a hybrid agent-based modeling and simulation (HABMS) approach, supported by high-performance computing (HPC), for simulating urban vector-borne disease transmission. Human residents are represented as mobile agents with stochastic infection dynamics, while mosquito populations are represented at the patch level through discrete-time equations. The model incorporates geospatial structure, temperature, land-use-based human movement, and local contextual information to represent transmission within urban environments. The framework was applied to Santa Marta, Colombia, as a city-specific case study. Transmission parameters were calibrated using surrogate-based Bayesian optimization, and their influence was assessed through sensitivity analysis. High-performance computing made the large number of stochastic simulations required for calibration and sensitivity analysis feasible. The calibrated model reproduced the magnitude and main seasonal shape of the observed dengue epidemic, including the peak and early decline. However, the model did not fully reproduce the late low-incidence tail of the season, indicating the need to incorporate external introductions of infection and rainfall-driven seasonal forcing of vector recruitment in future versions. A control scenario run on the calibrated baseline, a 30% reduction in larval carrying capacity, lowered the simulated seasonal attack rate by about three quarters and moved the system below the threshold at which local transmission is self-sustaining, illustrating the relative comparisons the calibrated model supports. This study contributes an adaptable hybrid model architecture and a high-performance implementation that make city-specific calibration and sensitivity analysis computationally feasible, demonstrated through a case study in Santa Marta.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Urban dengue transmission involves complex interactions among vector ecology, human mobility, climate, and spatial heterogeneity, but existing models often lack the detail needed for city-specific calibration and validation.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a hybrid agent-based modeling and simulation (HABMS) framework with high-performance computing to simulate urban dengue transmission, applying it as a city-specific case study in Santa Marta, Colombia.
analysis.methods: Human residents were modeled as mobile agents with stochastic infection dynamics, while mosquito populations were represented at the patch level using discrete-time equations, incorporating geospatial structure, temperature, land-use-based human movement, and local contextual information.
analysis.main_results: The calibrated model reproduced the magnitude and main seasonal shape of the observed dengue epidemic in Santa Marta, including the peak and early decline, but did not fully capture the late low-incidence tail of the season.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the model’s performance as demonstrating the feasibility of city-specific calibration and sensitivity analysis using a hybrid architecture, while noting the need to incorporate external infection introductions and rainfall-driven vector recruitment to improve late-season fit.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted reductions in larval carrying capacity could substantially lower seasonal dengue attack rates and push transmission below self-sustaining thresholds, informing local vector control strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The model’s inability to reproduce the late-season tail and the absence of explicit validation against external introductions limit confidence, warranting a moderate evidence strength despite computational feasibility.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a hybrid agent-based modeling and simulation (HABMS) framework, supported by high-performance computing, to simulate urban dengue transmission in a city-specific context. The model represents human residents as mobile agents with stochastic infection dynamics and mosquito populations at the patch level, integrating geospatial structure, temperature, human movement, and local contextual factors. Applied to Santa Marta, Colombia, the calibrated model reproduced the observed epidemic’s magnitude and seasonal shape, including the peak and early decline, but failed to capture the late low-incidence tail. The authors attribute this gap to unmodeled external infection introductions and rainfall-driven vector recruitment. A control scenario reducing larval carrying capacity by 30% lowered the simulated attack rate by about three quarters and pushed transmission below self-sustaining thresholds. While the framework demonstrates computational feasibility for city-specific calibration and sensitivity analysis, limitations include the model’s inability to fully reproduce late-season dynamics and the lack of validation against external introductions, resulting in a moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种具有高性能计算的基于代理的混合建模和模拟 (HABMS) 框架,用于模拟城市登革热 传播,并将其应用于哥伦比亚圣玛尔塔的城市特定案例研究。
elements_zh.methods: 人类居民被建模为具有随机感染动态的移动代理,而蚊子种群则使用离散时间方程在斑块级别上表示,并结合了地理空间结构、温度、基于土地利用的人类运动和当地背景信息。
elements_zh.main_results: 校准模型再现了在圣玛尔塔观察到的登革热疫情的强度和主要季节形状,包括峰值和早期下降,但没有完全捕捉到季节后期的低发病率尾部。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,有针对性地减少幼虫携带能力可以大大降低季节性登革热发病率,并使 传播 低于自我维持阈值,从而为当地的 媒介 控制策略提供信息。

Transmission parameters were calibrated using surrogate-based Bayesian optimization, and their influence was assessed through sensitivity analysis. High-performance computing made the large number of stochastic simulations required for calibration and sensitivity analysis feasible. The calibrated model reproduced the magnitude and main seasonal shape of the observed dengue epidemic, including the peak and early decline. However, the model did not fully reproduce the late low-incidence tail of the season, indicating the need to incorporate external introductions of infection and rainfall-driven seasonal forcing of vector recruitment in future versions. A control scenario run on the calibrated baseline, a 30% reduction in larval carrying capacity, lowered the simulated seasonal attack rate by about three quarters and moved the system below the threshold at which local transmission is self-sustaining, illustrating the relative comparisons the calibrated model supports. This study contributes an adaptable hybrid model architecture and a high-performance implementation that make city-specific calibration and sensitivity analysis computationally feasible, demonstrated through a case study in Santa Marta.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 城市登革热 传播 涉及 媒介 生态、人类流动性、气候和空间异质性之间的复杂相互作用,但现有模型往往缺乏特定城市校准和验证所需的细节。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种具有高性能计算的基于代理的混合建模和模拟 (HABMS) 框架,用于模拟城市登革热 传播,并将其应用于哥伦比亚圣玛尔塔的城市特定案例研究。

title: Obesity in children is associated with increased dengue virus binding, but not neutralizing, antibody responses following primary infection
abstract: Obesity has been associated with higher risk of dengue virus (DENV) infection and disease, yet its influence on antibody responses to DENV remains undefined. We evaluated whether nutritional status -- based on BMI z-score (BMIz) -- or blood markers of body fat -- leptin and adiponectin --are associated with binding and/or neutralizing antibody responses to DENV in 85 children in the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study who experienced a primary DENV infection in 2019. Associations were estimated using linear models adjusting for age, sex, and DENV infection outcome. Compared to children with normal weight, those with obesity had higher quantities of DENV binding antibodies (fold-change [FC] 1.89, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.02, 3.48) but no difference in neutralizing antibodies. Likewise, leptin concentration was associated with higher quantities of binding antibodies (FC 1.22, 95%CI 1.09, 1.37), while adiponectin was associated with lower quantities (FC 0.79, 95%CI 0.67, 0.94), and neither was associated with neutralizing antibodies. Lower neutralizing efficiency (neutralizing/binding antibodies) was observed in children with obesity (FC 0.67, 95%CI 0.48, 0.93). Our results indicate that obesity is associated with higher antibody quantity (binding) but not higher quality (neutralization) post-primary DENV infection -- implying that antibodies generated by children with obesity have lower neutralization efficiency, requiring greater quantities to reach similar levels of neutralization than children with normal weight. Further, the agreement among the three models using distinct proxies of body fat -- BMIz, leptin, and adiponectin -- demonstrates that adipokines are useful in supplementing BMIz analysis or as independent predictors of immune responses.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 85 children from the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study who experienced a primary DENV infection in 2019, evaluating associations between nutritional status or body fat markers and antibody responses.
analysis.methods: Associations between body mass index z-score (BMIz), leptin, adiponectin, and DENV antibody responses were estimated using linear models adjusted for age, sex, and DENV infection outcome.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether obesity and body fat markers (BMI z-score, leptin, adiponectin) influence dengue virus (DENV) antibody responses in 85 children from Nicaragua who experienced primary DENV infection in 2019. Using linear models adjusted for age, sex, and infection outcome, the authors found that children with obesity had significantly higher DENV binding antibody levels but no increase in neutralizing antibodies compared to normal-weight children. Leptin was positively associated with binding antibodies, while adiponectin showed an inverse association, and neither correlated with neutralizing antibodies. Neutralizing efficiency was lower in children with obesity. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that obesity may lead to higher antibody quantity but reduced functional quality, requiring greater antibody levels to achieve similar neutralization. They also suggest adipokines could complement BMIz in predicting immune responses. The study’s small sample size, single-cohort design, and observational nature limit generalizability and causal conclusions, warranting further research.

elements_zh.methods: 使用针对年龄、性别和 DENV 感染结果进行调整的线性模型来估计体重指数 z 得分 (BMIz)、瘦素、脂联素和 DENV 抗体反应之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: Children with obesity had 1.89-fold higher DENV binding antibodies (95% CI 1.02, 3.48) but no difference in neutralizing antibodies compared to normal-weight children. elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小、单一队列研究设计以及缺乏机制探索的限制,限制了普遍性和因果推理。由于这些限制和分析的观察性质,证据是中等的。

title: Prognosis of vector borne dengue disease outbreak in urban areas using multivariate analysis
abstract: Vector borne disease like dengue continues to pose a significant climate-sensitive public health challenge in tropical regions such as Brazil, Peru, and India. This study examines the feasibility of predicting dengue outbreaks using weekly multivariate time-series data from San Juan (SJ), Puerto Rico and Iquitos (IQ), Peru. Dengue incidence was analyzed alongside meteorological, environmental, and vegetation-based variables to capture key climatic influences. Several machine learning and deep learning approaches were evaluated, including LightGBM. Model performance was assessed using root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE). The results show that LightGBM achieved the low est RMSE/MAE, indicating strong short-term predictive accuracy and excellent interpretability. Feature importance analysis and principal component analysis (PCA) identified precipitation, dew point temperature, and humidity as the most influential predictors of dengue incidence. The study demonstrates that advanced machine learning models can serve as reliable early warning systems for vector-borne diseases. While this research focuses on dengue, the methodology is adaptable to other vector-bone datasets and diseases, offering a flexible tool for public health authorities to predict and mitigate outbreaks in diverse urban contexts.
journal: International Journal of Informatics and Communication Technology (IJ-ICT)

title_zh: 使用多变量分析预测城市地区 媒介 传播的登革热疾病 暴发
source_body_en: Vector borne disease like dengue continues to pose a significant climate-sensitive public health challenge in tropical regions such as Brazil, Peru, and India. This study examines the feasibility of predicting dengue outbreaks using weekly multivariate time-series data from San Juan (SJ), Puerto Rico and Iquitos (IQ), Peru. Dengue incidence was analyzed alongside meteorological, environmental, and vegetation-based variables to capture key climatic influences. Several machine learning and deep learning approaches were evaluated, including LightGBM. Model performance was assessed using root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE). The results show that LightGBM achieved the low est RMSE/MAE, indicating strong short-term predictive accuracy and excellent interpretability. Feature importance analysis and principal component analysis (PCA) identified precipitation, dew point temperature, and humidity as the most influential predictors of dengue incidence. The study demonstrates that advanced machine learning models can serve as reliable early warning systems for vector-borne diseases. While this research focuses on dengue, the methodology is adaptable to other vector-bone datasets and diseases, offering a flexible tool for public health authorities to predict and mitigate outbreaks in diverse urban contexts.
abstract_zh: 媒介 登革热等传播疾病继续对巴西、秘鲁和印度等热带地区的气候敏感型公共卫生构成重大挑战。本研究探讨了使用来自波多黎各圣胡安 (SJ) 和秘鲁伊基托斯 (IQ) 的每周多元时间序列数据预测登革热 暴发 的可行性。登革热 发病率 与气象、环境和植被变量一起进行分析,以捕捉关键的气候影响。评估了多种机器学习和深度学习方法,包括 LightGBM。使用均方根误差(RMSE)和平均绝对误差(MAE)评估模型性能。结果表明,LightGBM 实现了最低的 RMSE/MAE,表明其具有很强的短期预测准确性和出色的可解释性。特征重要性分析和主成分分析 (PCA) 确定降水量、露点温度和湿度是登革热 发病率 最有影响力的预测因素。该研究表明,先进的机器学习模型可以作为 媒介 传播疾病的可靠早期预警系统。虽然这项研究的重点是登革热,但该方法适用于其他 媒介 骨数据集和疾病,为公共卫生当局提供了一个灵活的工具,可以在不同的城市环境中预测和减轻 暴发 的影响。

title: REFLEXÕES SOBRE A INFLUÊNCIA DE FATORES METEOROLÓGICOS E DE SANEAMENTO AMBIENTAL NA OCORRÊNCIA DA DENGUE REFLECTIONS ON THE INFLUENCE OF METEOROLOGICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL SANITATION FACTORS ON THE OCCURRENCE OF DENGUE REFLEXIONES SOBRE LA INFLUENCIA DE LOS FACTORES METEOROLÓGICOS Y DE SANEAMIENTO AMBIENTAL EN LA APARICIÓN DEL DENGUE
abstract: Introdução: A dengue é uma das arboviroses de maior persistência com impacto global, cuja ocorrência da doença é potencializada por condições climáticas e precariedade do saneamento ambiental que favorecem o ciclo de vida do mosquito transmissor Aedes aegypti. Objetivo: Este texto tem por objetivo relatar a experiência de uma ação de extensão universitária voltada à educação básica para discutir a influência de fatores ambientais na ocorrência da dengue. Metodologia: Foi planejada uma ação de extensão para o desenvolvimento de atividades educativas no formato de palestra voltada para estudantes da rede pública de ensino, no município de Feira de Santana-Ba. Atividade foi estruturada a partir do levantamento de materiais didáticos para implementação da palestra, que ocorreu de forma dialogada, foi proposto à aplicação de quiz interativo; e mapeamento socioambiental via questionário, além da utilização de materiais informativos como folders, para ampliar o acesso a informações oficiais além da palestra. Resultados: Atividade demonstrou alta potencialidade pedagógica, sobretudo quanto aplicação do quiz que promoveu intensa participação espontânea. Os relatos dos estudantes revelam um cenário de vulnerabilidade quanto as condições de saneamento ambiental que rodeiam suas moradias. Além disso, observou-se baixa adesão ao questionário escrito impossibilitando uma análise quantitativa. Conclusão: Diante dos resultados a ação de extensão mostrou-se uma estratégia eficaz para a promoção da conscientização e combate ao mosquito transmissor da dengue no âmbito escolar, favorecendo a ampliação do conhecimento e dos seus fatores condicionantes. Dessa forma, evidencia-se a importância da integração entre universidade e escola na construção de ações educativas contínuas, para compreensão e redução dos fatores de risco associados à doença.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the persistent global burden of dengue, a mosquito-borne arboviral disease, and highlights environmental sanitation deficits and climatic conditions as drivers of Aedes aegypti proliferation and transmission. It frames the need for educational interventions to raise awareness of these risk factors among school-aged populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study reports a university extension activity conducted as an educational lecture for public school students in Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil. The activity targeted basic education settings to discuss environmental factors influencing dengue occurrence.
analysis.methods: The intervention consisted of a dialogic lecture supplemented by interactive quiz activities, socio-environmental mapping via questionnaire, and distribution of informational folders. Materials were prepared and delivered to enhance access to official information beyond the lecture format.
analysis.main_results: The activity demonstrated high pedagogical potential, particularly through the interactive quiz that elicited spontaneous participation. However, low adherence to the written questionnaire prevented quantitative analysis of socio-environmental conditions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the activity as an effective strategy for raising awareness and combating the dengue vector within schools, expanding knowledge of risk factors. They emphasize the novelty of integrating university and school efforts to foster continuous educational actions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that school-based educational interventions can enhance community understanding of dengue risk factors and support vector control efforts. They underscore the value of partnerships between universities and schools for sustained public health education.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s evidence strength is limited by the absence of quantitative data due to low questionnaire response rates and the lack of target-specific laboratory or epidemiological measurements. The design restricts generalizability beyond the local educational context.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes a university-led educational intervention in Feira de Santana, Brazil, aimed at raising awareness among public school students about environmental and sanitation factors influencing dengue transmission. The activity combined a dialogic lecture with an interactive quiz, socio-environmental questionnaires, and informational materials. While the quiz demonstrated strong pedagogical engagement, low questionnaire response rates precluded quantitative analysis of local sanitation vulnerabilities. The authors conclude that such school-based initiatives effectively promote dengue vector control awareness and knowledge of risk factors, advocating for sustained university–school partnerships. However, the evidence is constrained by the absence of quantitative data and target-specific measurements, limiting broader public health inferences.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了登革热(一种蚊媒虫媒病毒性疾病)在全球范围内持续造成的负担,并强调环境卫生缺陷和气候条件是埃及伊蚊扩散和 传播 的驱动因素。它提出了教育干预的必要性,以提高学龄人口对这些风险因素的认识。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究报告了在巴西巴伊亚州费拉德桑塔纳为公立学校学生举办的一项大学推广活动,作为教育讲座。该活动针对基础教育环境,讨论影响登革热发生的环境因素。
elements_zh.methods: 干预措施包括对话讲座,辅以互动测验活动、通过问卷绘制社会环境图以及分发信息文件夹。材料的准备和交付是为了增强对讲座形式之外的官方信息的获取。
elements_zh.main_results: 该活动展示了很高的教学潜力,特别是通过引发自发参与的互动测验。然而,对书面调查问卷的遵守率较低,阻碍了对社会环境条件的定量分析。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此活动解释为在学校内提高认识和抗击登革热 媒介、扩大对危险因素的了解的有效策略。他们强调整合大学和学校的努力以促进持续教育行动的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,以学校为基础的教育干预措施可以增强社区对登革热危险因素的了解,并支持 媒介 控制工作。他们强调大学和学校之间的伙伴关系对于持续公共卫生教育的价值。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于问卷答复率低以及缺乏针对具体目标的实验室或流行病学测量,导致缺乏定量数据,该研究的证据强度受到限制。该设计限制了当地教育背景之外的普遍性。

title: A LUDICIDADE NA PREVENÇÃO DA DENGUE EM ESCOLARES: RELATO DE EXPERIÊNCIA DE CURRICULARIZAÇÃO DA EXTENSÃO EM CURITIBA PLAYFUL APPROACHES TO DENGUE PREVENTION IN SCHOOLCHILDREN: AN ACCOUNT OF CURRICULAR EXTENSION EXPERIENCE IN CURITIBA
abstract: Dengue fever remains a significant public health problem in Brazil, requiring ongoing health education strategies for vulnerable populations. This article reports a health education extension experience focused on dengue prevention, conducted with 32 second-grade elementary school students at Escola Municipal Irati, in the Cajuru neighborhood of Curitiba, during the first semester of 2024, linked to the Teaching and Community Integration curricular unit of the Medicine course at Faculdades Pequeno Principe. The intervention combined a dialogued conversation with a playful activity called Dengue Informant, in which children identified Aedes aegypti breeding sites across the school yard. Good adherence, progressive understanding of preventive behaviors, and high engagement were observed. The experience highlighted the potential of playful methodologies for child health promotion and reinforced the role of curricular extension in shaping socially committed medical professionals.

title: Kiến thức, thực hành về phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết dengue của sinh viên nội trú Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025 Knowledge and practices on dengue Fever Prevention among Domitory Students at Hanoi Medical University in 2025
abstract: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang được thực hiện trên 402 sin h viên nội tr ú Trường Đại h ọc Y H à Nội nhằm mô tảkiế n thức và thực hành phòng chống sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD). Dữ liệu được thu thập bằng bảnghỏi trực tuyến và phân tích bằng thống kê mô tả kết hợp với phân tích nhân tố khám phá. Kết quả cho thấy53,5% sinh viên có kiến thức tốt, trong khi chỉ 13,2% có thực hành phòng bệnh tốt. Phần lớn sinh viênbiết các biện pháp phòng chống SXHD như bôi thuốc chống muỗi (86,1%), mặc quần áo dài (79,1%), ngủmàn chống muỗi (74,1%), kiểm tra dụng cụ chứa nước (84,3%), thu gom phế thải (83,6%) và lật úp dụngcụ chứa nước (81,8%). Tuy nhiên, kiến thức về sử dụng hóa chất diệt bọ gậy còn hạn chế (49,0%). Phântích nhân tố khám phá xác định 3 nhóm thực hành gồm: “Thực hành phòng chống chủ động”, “Kiểm soátmuỗi và bọ gậy” và “Phòng tránh cá nhân”, với điểm trung bình từ 2,0 đến 2,9. Các thực hành được thựchiện ở mức “rất thường xuyên” với tỷ lệ cao hơn là ngủ màn vào ban đêm (12,4%), cọ rửa dụng cụ chứanước (11,2%), mặc quần áo dài và lật úp dụng cụ chứa nước (9,5%). Ngược lại, thả hóa chất diệt bọ gậyvào dụng cụ đọng nước có tỷ lệ thấp nhất, chỉ 2,7%. Kết quả cho thấy mặc dù hơn một nửa sinh viên cókiến thức tốt, thực hành phòng chống SXHD vẫn còn hạn chế. Do đó, cần tăng cường giáo dục sức khỏevà các chiến lược thay đổi hành vi để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng bền vững các biện pháp phòng ngừa sốt xuấthuyết trong sinh viên đại học.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health problem of dengue fever among university students in Hanoi by assessing knowledge and practices for its prevention. It aimed to describe current levels of dengue-related knowledge and preventive practices among dormitory students at Hanoi Medical University.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 402 dormitory students at Hanoi Medical University in 2025. Data were collected using an online questionnaire and analyzed with descriptive statistics and exploratory factor analysis.
analysis.methods: An online questionnaire was used to collect data on knowledge and practices regarding dengue prevention. Descriptive statistics and exploratory factor analysis were applied to categorize and interpret the responses.
analysis.main_results: 53.5% of students demonstrated good knowledge of dengue prevention, while only 13.2% exhibited good preventive practices. Commonly known measures included using mosquito repellent (86.1%), wearing long clothing (79.1%), using bed nets (74.1%), checking water containers (84.3%), waste collection (83.6%), and turning over water containers (81.8%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Despite high awareness of preventive measures, actual practice levels were low, indicating a gap between knowledge and behavior. The study identified three practice domains: active prevention, mosquito and larval control, and personal protection, with average scores ranging from 2.0 to 2.9.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the need for targeted health education and behavior-change strategies to improve the adoption of dengue prevention measures among university students in Hanoi.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit causal inference and may introduce reporting bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the single-center setting and lack of validation of reported practices.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated knowledge and preventive practices against dengue fever among 402 dormitory students at Hanoi Medical University in 2025. Using an online questionnaire and descriptive statistics with exploratory factor analysis, it found that 53.5% of students had good knowledge of dengue prevention, but only 13.2% demonstrated good preventive practices. While students were aware of measures such as using mosquito repellent (86.1%), wearing long clothing (79.1%), and using bed nets (74.1%), actual practice levels were low. The study identified three practice domains: active prevention, mosquito and larval control, and personal protection, with average scores between 2.0 and 2.9. Despite high awareness, the gap between knowledge and practice underscores the need for targeted health education and behavior-change interventions to promote sustainable dengue prevention among university students.

title_zh: Kiến thức,thực hành về phòng,chống sốt xuất huyết dengue của sinh viên nội trú Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025年知识和实践登革热 2025年河内医科大学宿舍学生预防情况
source_body_en: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang được thực hiện trên 402 sin h viên nội tr ú Trường Đại h ọc Y H à Nội nhằm mô tảkiế n thức và thực hành phòng chống sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD). Dữ liệu được thu thập bằng bảnghỏi trực tuyến và phân tích bằng thống kê mô tả kết hợp với phân tích nhân tố khám phá. Kết quả cho thấy53,5% sinh viên có kiến thức tốt, trong khi chỉ 13,2% có thực hành phòng bệnh tốt. Phần lớn sinh viênbiết các biện pháp phòng chống SXHD như bôi thuốc chống muỗi (86,1%), mặc quần áo dài (79,1%), ngủmàn chống muỗi (74,1%), kiểm tra dụng cụ chứa nước (84,3%), thu gom phế thải (83,6%) và lật úp dụngcụ chứa nước (81,8%). Tuy nhiên, kiến thức về sử dụng hóa chất diệt bọ gậy còn hạn chế (49,0%). Phântích nhân tố khám phá xác định 3 nhóm thực hành gồm: “Thực hành phòng chống chủ động”, “Kiểm soátmuỗi và bọ gậy” và “Phòng tránh cá nhân”, với điểm trung bình từ 2,0 đến 2,9. Các thực hành được thựchiện ở mức “rất thường xuyên” với tỷ lệ cao hơn là ngủ màn vào ban đêm (12,4%), cọ rửa dụng cụ chứanước (11,2%), mặc quần áo dài và lật úp dụng cụ chứa nước (9,5%). Ngược lại, thả hóa chất diệt bọ gậyvào dụng cụ đọng nước có tỷ lệ thấp nhất, chỉ 2,7%. Kết quả cho thấy mặc dù hơn một nửa sinh viên cókiến thức tốt, thực hành phòng chống SXHD vẫn còn hạn chế. Do đó, cần tăng cường giáo dục sức khỏevà các chiến lược thay đổi hành vi để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng bền vững các biện pháp phòng ngừa sốt xuấthuyết trong sinh viên đại học.

title: Chikungunya Virus serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings: Mechanisms, Diagnostic implications, and epidemiological consequences
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.
journal: World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines serological cross-reactivity affecting Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) diagnostics in co-endemic settings, focusing on the pathogen CHIKV, its disease manifestations, and the central question of how antibody-based assays can be improved to avoid misclassification in regions where multiple arboviruses co-circulate.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a narrative review that distinguishes three phenomena—biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification—using evidence from studies on CHIKV and related alphaviruses, including CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV), and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV), while noting the lack of biological basis for CHIKV reactivity in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that CHIKV shares antigenic architecture with ONNV, MAYV, and RRV, supported by shared alphavirus antigenic structure and functional cross-neutralisation in several studies, whereas CHIKV reactivity in DENV- and ZIKV-associated sera is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity without an established biological basis.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves cross-reactivity for every virus pair, particularly in co-endemic settings where multiple arboviruses circulate together.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends a layered diagnostic strategy for CHIKV in co-endemic settings: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, and cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance, with a focus on strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing in African settings such as Nigeria.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses serological cross-reactivity challenges in diagnosing Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in co-endemic regions where multiple arboviruses circulate. It introduces a framework distinguishing biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification, noting that CHIKV shares antigenic architecture with related alphaviruses like O'nyong-nyong, Mayaro, and Ross River viruses, supported by functional cross-neutralisation. However, CHIKV reactivity in dengue or Zika virus-associated sera lacks biological basis and is classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity. The review underscores that unadjusted seropositivity can distort CHIKV transmission estimates and that no single diagnostic platform resolves cross-reactivity across all virus pairs. It advocates for a multi-layered diagnostic approach—molecular testing acutely, antigenically informed multiplex serology subsequently, neutralisation-based confirmation when necessary, and statistical modelling that accounts for cross-reactivity—with emphasis on improving assay validation and confirmatory testing in high-risk regions such as Nigeria.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述研究了在共流行环境中影响基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 诊断的血清学交叉反应性,重点关注病原体 CHIKV、其疾病表现,以及如何改进基于抗体的检测以避免在多种虫媒病毒共同传播的地区发生错误分类的核心问题。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一篇叙述性综述,使用 CHIKV 和相关甲病毒(包括 CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong 病毒 (ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro 病毒 (MAYV) 和 CHIKV-Ross River 病毒 (RRV))研究的证据区分了三种现象——生物交叉反应性、检测相关的非靶标反应性和诊断错误分类,同时指出 CHIKV 反应性缺乏生物学基础。登革病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 相关血清。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,CHIKV 与 ONNV、MAYV 和 RRV 具有相同的抗原结构,并得到多项研究中共享的甲病毒抗原结构和功能性交叉中和的支持,而 DENV 和 ZIKV 相关血清中的 CHIKV 反应性在没有既定生物学基础的情况下,更好地归类为与检测相关的非靶标反应性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调,未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的交叉反应性,特别是在多种虫媒病毒一起传播的共流行环境中。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议在共流行环境下对 CHIKV 采取分层诊断策略:急性期进行分子检测,之后进行抗原信息和多重 血清学,基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),以及 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型,重点是加强尼日利亚等非洲地区的测定验证和确认性测试。

analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves cross-reactivity for every virus pair, particularly in co-endemic settings where multiple arboviruses circulate together.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends a layered diagnostic strategy for CHIKV in co-endemic settings: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, and cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance, with a focus on strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing in African settings such as Nigeria.

title_zh: 共流行环境中基孔肯雅病毒血清学交叉反应:机制、诊断意义和流行病学后果
source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.
abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 会引起急性发热性疾病并伴有关节痛,血清学检测仍然是其 诊断 和 监测 的核心。然而,在多种虫媒病毒共同循环的环境中,基于抗体的结果因交叉反应而变得复杂。本综述区分了影响 CHIKV 血清学 的三种相关但不同的现象:生物交叉反应性,由相关病毒之间真正的抗原重叠引起;与检测相关的非目标反应性,其中诊断平台在病毒之间没有建立生物学关系的情况下产生阳性信号;诊断错误分类,将两者混为一谈的下游流行病学后果。将该框架应用于五个病毒对,我们发现CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong病毒(ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro病毒(MAYV)和CHIKV-罗斯河病毒(RRV)关系得到了共享的甲病毒抗原结构的支持,并且在一些研究中还得到了功能性交叉中和的支持。相比之下,登革病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 相关血清中报告的 CHIKV 反应性缺乏既定的生物学基础,最好归类为未解决机制的检测相关非靶标反应性。这些区别很重要:未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的问题。我们认为,共流行环境中的 CHIKV 诊断 需要分层策略:急性期进行分子检测,随后进行抗原告知和多重 血清学,以及基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),并结合 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型。加强分析验证和确认性检测,特别是在尼日利亚等 CHIKV、DENV 和相关甲病毒共同传播的非洲地区,对于提高诊断准确性和流行病学推断至关重要。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述研究了在共流行环境中影响基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 诊断的血清学交叉反应性,重点关注病原体 CHIKV、其疾病表现,以及如何改进基于抗体的检测以避免在多种虫媒病毒共同传播的地区发生错误分类的核心问题。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一篇叙述性综述,使用 CHIKV 和相关甲病毒(包括 CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong 病毒 (ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro 病毒 (MAYV) 和 CHIKV-Ross River 病毒 (RRV))研究的证据区分了三种现象——生物交叉反应性、检测相关的非靶标反应性和诊断错误分类,同时指出 CHIKV 反应性缺乏生物学基础。登革病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 相关血清。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,CHIKV 与 ONNV、MAYV 和 RRV 具有相同的抗原结构,并得到多项研究中共享的甲病毒抗原结构和功能性交叉中和的支持,而 DENV 和 ZIKV 相关血清中的 CHIKV 反应性在没有既定生物学基础的情况下,更好地归类为与检测相关的非靶标反应性。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调,未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的交叉反应性,特别是在多种虫媒病毒一起传播的共流行环境中。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议在共流行环境下对 CHIKV 采取分层诊断策略:急性期进行分子检测,之后进行抗原信息和多重 血清学,基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),以及 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型,重点是加强尼日利亚等非洲地区的测定验证和确认性测试。

title: Parameters affecting dengue virus replication in Vero cells
abstract: Dengue has become a global threat affecting millions of people annually and contributing to a significant mortality burden. Although vaccination is the most effective approach to prevent this disease in dengue-endemic regions, the development of a robust and scalable production process is urgently required to maximize vaccine yield. The current study aimed to optimize the key growth parameters of four recombinant live attenuated dengue serotypes, including harvest schedule, temperature, Multiplicity of infection (MOI), and metabolite concentration. Growth kinetics data, followed by a scale-up study, established the feasibility of multiple harvests for all four serotypes within a defined production window, with the first harvest optimally occurring between Days 4 and 8. All serotypes demonstrated strong responsiveness to low MOIs and temperature shifts, resulting in 2- to 25-fold increases in titer within a reduced time frame. Furthermore, metabolite profiling revealed distinct glutamine and glucose consumption dynamics, highlighting its importance for optimizing infection media. Taken together, these findings provide valuable insights into dengue virus production and define critical parameters that can support future optimization studies and large-scale production.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue poses a major global health burden, and while vaccination is the most effective preventive measure, scalable vaccine production remains a bottleneck. The study was needed to identify parameters that could optimize dengue virus replication for vaccine manufacturing.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study investigated four recombinant live attenuated dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) in Vero cells to determine optimal growth conditions for virus replication.
analysis.methods: The authors evaluated key growth parameters including harvest schedule, temperature, multiplicity of infection (MOI), and metabolite concentration, followed by growth kinetics analysis and a scale-up study.
analysis.main_results: All four dengue serotypes showed strong responsiveness to low MOIs and temperature shifts, resulting in 2- to 25-fold increases in viral titer within a reduced time frame. Metabolite profiling identified distinct glutamine and glucose consumption dynamics critical for optimizing infection media.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings define critical parameters for dengue virus production, demonstrating that optimized MOI, temperature, and metabolite conditions can enhance viral yield and reduce production time.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results directly inform efforts to scale up dengue vaccine production, potentially improving vaccine availability in endemic regions by optimizing bioprocess parameters.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to in vitro Vero cell culture systems and does not address in vivo replication or clinical outcomes, warranting caution in extrapolating findings to vaccine manufacturing or public health impact.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to optimize dengue virus replication in Vero cells for vaccine production by evaluating harvest schedule, temperature, multiplicity of infection (MOI), and metabolite concentration. Growth kinetics and scale-up analyses showed that all four dengue serotypes responded robustly to low MOI and temperature shifts, achieving 2- to 25-fold titer increases within a shortened timeframe. Metabolite profiling revealed distinct glutamine and glucose consumption patterns, highlighting their role in optimizing infection media. The findings provide actionable parameters for enhancing viral yield and reducing production time, which are critical for scaling dengue vaccine manufacturing. However, the study is limited to in vitro systems and does not address in vivo replication or clinical efficacy, restricting direct translation to public health applications.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在 Vero 细胞中研究了四种重组活减毒登革热血清型(DENV-1 至 DENV-4),以确定病毒复制的最佳生长条件。
elements_zh.methods: 作者评估了关键生长参数,包括收获时间表、温度、感染复数 (MOI) 和代谢物浓度,然后进行生长动力学分析和放大研究。

analysis_zh.methods: 作者评估了关键生长参数,包括收获时间表、温度、感染复数 (MOI) 和代谢物浓度,然后进行生长动力学分析和放大研究。
analysis_zh.main_results: 所有四种登革热血清型均对低 MOI 和温度变化表现出强烈的响应性,导致病毒滴度在较短的时间内增加 2 至 25 倍。代谢分析确定了不同的谷氨酰胺和葡萄糖消耗动态,这对于优化感染介质至关重要。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果定义了 登革病毒 生产的关键参数,证明优化的 MOI、温度和代谢条件可以提高病毒产量并缩短生产时间。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果直接为扩大登革热 疫苗 生产的努力提供了信息,通过优化生物工艺参数,有可能提高 疫苗 在流行地区的可用性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于体外 Vero 细胞培养系统,并不涉及体内复制或临床结果,因此在将研究结果外推到 疫苗 制造或公共卫生影响时需要谨慎。

title: Molecular and biophysical requirements for B cell receptor-dependent enhancement of dengue virus infection
abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) is the causative agent of dengue, a mosquito-borne disease that represents a significant and growing public health burden around the world. A unique pathophysiological feature of dengue is immune-mediated enhancement, wherein preexisting immunity elicited by a primary infection can enhance the severity of a subsequent infection by a heterologous DENV serotype. A leading mechanistic explanation for this phenomenon is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells. Accordingly, this model posits that phagocytic mononuclear cells are the primary reservoir of DENV. However, multiple independent groups have shown that B cells are the largest reservoir of virally infected cells in circulation during acute dengue, representing a disconnect in our understanding of immune-mediated DENV tropism. In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. In this study, we show that DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Finally, we show that immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes. We propose that BDE provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis. IMPORTANCE This study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Immune-mediated enhancement of infection is a cornerstone of dengue immunopathogenesis and is most often attributed to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). BCR-dependent enhancement of DENV infection is an alternative and complementary mechanism for immune-mediated enhancement that addresses several persistent knowledge gaps in the dengue field and may offer mechanistic insight into why some people progress to severe dengue after infection.

A leading mechanistic explanation for immune-mediated enhancement is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study investigates the molecular and biophysical requirements for B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of DENV infection. The research focuses on DENV-reactive B cells and their interaction with DENV envelope (E) protein during acute dengue.
analysis.methods: The study examines DENV entry into B cells, highlighting that it is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are used to demonstrate productive infection by live DENV, supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes.
analysis.main_results: DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors propose that B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection, which may help explain why some people progress to severe dengue after infection and inform future research on DENV immunopathogenesis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which may limit the depth of analysis. However, the findings are grounded in the direct observation of DENV entry and replication in B cells, supporting a high confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the molecular and biophysical mechanisms underlying B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Dengue virus is a significant public health burden, and immune-mediated enhancement, particularly antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), is a key factor in disease severity. The research identifies that DENV entry into B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and occurs in late endosomes. Immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are shown to support active viral replication of all four serotypes, suggesting BDE complements existing models of ADE. The findings offer new insights into DENV immunopathogenesis and may help explain why some individuals progress to severe dengue. The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits detailed analysis but supports a high confidence assessment due to the direct observation of DENV interactions with B cells.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 (DENV) 是登革热的病原体,登革热是一种蚊媒疾病,给全世界带来了巨大且日益严重的公共卫生负担。免疫介导增强的一个主要机制解释是 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE),其中亚中和浓度的 DENV 特异性 IgG 抗体有利于 DENV 进入表达 FcγR 的细胞。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性增强 DENV 感染的分子和生物物理要求。该研究重点关注 DENV 反应性 B 细胞及其在急性登革热期间与 DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白的相互作用。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究检查了 DENV 进入 B 细胞的情况,强调它是动力介导的,需要近端 BCR 信号传导,并涉及晚期内体的定位。永生化的 DENV 反应性 B 细胞用于证明活 DENV 的有效感染,支持所有四种血清型的活跃病毒复制。
elements_zh.main_results: DENV 反应性 B 细胞的 DENV 感染对 BCR/DENV 包膜 (E) 蛋白相互作用高度敏感。DENV 进入 B 细胞亚群是由动力介导的,需要近端 BCR 信号传导,并涉及晚期内体的定位。永生化的 DENV 反应性 B 细胞可被活 DENV 有效感染,能够支持所有四种血清型的活跃病毒复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者提出,B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性增强 (BDE) 提供了一层额外的病原体特异性免疫介导的感染风险,补充了现有的 ADE 模型,并为 DENV 免疫发病机制的潜在机制提供了更多见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这项研究提供了对 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 依赖性 重症登革热 (DENV) 感染增强过程的机制见解,这可能有助于解释为什么有些人在感染后进展为 重症登革热,并为未来有关 DENV 免疫发病机制的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象证据,这可能会限制分析的深度。然而,这些发现基于对 B 细胞中 DENV 进入和复制的直接观察,支持高置信度评估。

title: Characteristic skin rash among patients with dengue fever: case series
abstract: Background: Dengue fever (DF) is caused by the dengue virus, which manifests with systemic features such as fever, malaise, and headache. More than 50% of cases present with a variety of skin lesions. Case Presentation: We present a series of three cases that presented to the clinic with fever associated with gastrointestinal symptoms, including nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Other systematic reviews were unremarkable. The patients subsequently developed a pruritic skin rash characterized by diffuse confluent erythema with petechiae and rounded islands of sparing. After excluding alternative etiologies such as malaria, HIV, and hepatitis C, all three patients were diagnosed with DF. Conclusion: This case series highlights the presence of a characteristic rash in DF. We emphasize the clinical description of this cutaneous manifestation, which is not well-described in previous literature. Although cutaneous manifestations are common in dengue, identifying these specific rash patterns can contribute to accurate and early diagnosis. Patients presenting with fever and rashes in an endemic area should be suspected of having DF.

abstract: Introducción: El dengue constituye una de las arbovirosis de mayor impacto en la salud pública mundial. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the significant public health impact of dengue and the need for updated scientific understanding of its structure, pathogenesis, immune response, diagnosis and vaccines. The research was motivated by the global burden of dengue disease.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study conducted a descriptive and analytical documentary review, selecting 20 studies based on the PRISMA protocol. It focused on dengue virus and related aspects of dengue disease.
analysis.methods: The authors performed a documentary review using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, SciELO, Dialnet, Redalyc and ERIC databases. They followed the PRISMA protocol to select and analyze 20 studies.
analysis.main_results: The results indicated that structural and non-structural proteins of the dengue virus are essential for replication and immune evasion. Antibody-dependent enhancement and endothelial dysfunction were identified as key factors in severe dengue. Molecular tests and NS1 antigen detection enable early diagnosis.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the importance of understanding the virus's structure and immune interactions to develop effective strategies for dengue control. This study provides a comprehensive overview of current scientific knowledge on dengue.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, early diagnosis and vaccine development efforts for dengue. They emphasize the need for integrated approaches to manage the disease effectively.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a review of existing literature and does not include original data. The evidence is strong due to the systematic selection of studies using PRISMA, but it may not capture the most recent developments.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides a comprehensive review of the scientific evidence on the dengue virus, focusing on its structure, pathogenesis, immune response, diagnosis and vaccines. The authors conducted a descriptive and analytical documentary review of 20 studies selected via the PRISMA protocol, highlighting the essential roles of structural and non-structural proteins in viral replication and immune evasion. They also identified antibody-dependent enhancement and endothelial dysfunction as critical factors in severe dengue and emphasized the importance of molecular tests and NS1 antigen detection for early diagnosis. The study concludes that effective dengue control requires integrated strategies involving surveillance, diagnosis, vector control and vaccination. The findings are significant for advancing understanding and management of dengue but are limited to a literature review without original data. The evidence is strong due to the systematic approach, but it may not fully capture recent advancements in the field.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决登革热对公共卫生的重大影响,以及对其结构 发病机制、免疫应答、诊断 和 疫苗 进行更新的科学理解的需要。这项研究的动机是全球登革热疾病负担。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究进行了描述性和分析性文献综述,根据 PRISMA 协议选择了 20 项研究。它重点关注 登革病毒 和登革热疾病的相关方面。
elements_zh.methods: 作者使用 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、SciELO、Dialnet、Redalyc 和 ERIC 数据库进行了文献综述。他们按照 PRISMA 协议选择并分析了 20 项研究。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,登革病毒 的结构和非结构蛋白对于复制和免疫逃避至关重要。抗体依赖性增强 和内皮功能障碍被确定为 重症登革热 的关键因素。分子测试和 NS1 抗原检测可实现早期 诊断。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调了解病毒结构和免疫相互作用对于制定有效的登革热控制策略的重要性。这项研究全面概述了当前有关登革热的科学知识。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为 监测、早期 诊断 和 疫苗 登革热的开发工作提供信息。他们强调需要采取综合方法来有效管理该疾病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于对现有文献的回顾,不包括原始数据。由于使用 PRISMA 系统地选择了研究,因此证据很充分,但它可能无法反映最新的进展。

title: Ecoregion-specific dengue risk prediction in Peru using remote sensing, machine learning, and spatiotemporal modeling
abstract: : Dengue fever has been a significant public health issue in Peru due to its highly localized and cyclical nature and to changes in the environment, demography, and climate. While many existing models can assess dengue risk at the country level, they often fail to account for the fine-scale landscape variation that drives varying transmission rates. We developed a spatiotemporal dengue risk model at a 1 km spatial resolution by integrating high-resolution climatic, land-cover, and demographic variables across 20 years (2003-2022) of dengue surveillance data. Tree-based approaches achieved higher predictive accuracy than linear models, with XGBoost achieving the highest R 2 value of 0.68. Additionally, model performance increased when spatially and temporally lagged predictors were included. Land surface temperature and precipitation showed strong neighborhood effects on dengue suitability. Specifically, there exists a strong spatial dependency in model validation across 14 ecoregions, with Amazon moist forest and transitional Yungas yielding high predictive accuracy (R 2 = 0.78), while high-altitude Andean Puna and coastal mangrove zones had poor predictive accuracy, performing worse than the mean prediction, suggesting non-climatic factors such as human mobility and imported transmission also play a role in dengue infection and transmissions. Overall, the predictability of dengue is strongly dependent on the ecoregion where it occurs, with national-level averages masking local dynamics. Our research demonstrates the potential for scalable high-resolution risk mapping when combined with ecoregion-specific performance metrics to predict and inform targeted vector control and public health interventions for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases.

abstract_zh: :由于其高度局部化和周期性以及环境、人口和气候的变化,登革热 一直是秘鲁的一个重大公共卫生问题。虽然许多现有模型可以评估国家一级的登革热风险,但它们往往无法考虑导致 传播 发生率变化的精细景观变化。我们通过整合 20 年(2003-2022 年)登革热 监测 数据的高分辨率气候、土地覆盖和人口变量,开发了 1 公里空间分辨率的时空登革热风险模型。基于树的方法比线性模型实现了更高的预测精度,XGBoost 实现了最高 R 2 值 0.68。此外,当包含空间和时间滞后的预测变量时,模型性能会提高。地表温度和降水对登革热适宜性表现出强烈的邻域效应。具体而言,14个生态区的模型验证存在很强的空间依赖性,其中亚马逊潮湿森林和过渡性云加斯地区的预测精度较高(R 2 = 0.78),而高海拔安第斯普纳和沿海红树林区的预测精度较差,表现差于平均预测,这表明人口流动和进口传播等非气候因素也在登革热感染和传播中发挥作用。总体而言,登革热的可预测性在很大程度上取决于其发生的生态区,国家水平的平均值掩盖了当地的动态。我们的研究表明,与特定生态区域的绩效指标相结合,可进行可扩展的高分辨率风险测绘,以预测和告知针对气候敏感型 媒介 传播疾病的有针对性的 媒介 控制和公共卫生干预措施。
